worker_model.note: One pinned worker for every arm (pilot continuity). Dated snapshot so the alias cannot drift mid-run.

arms.name: invented-a1
arms.note: A1: nano planner + nano workers ('as deployed cheaply'; pilot continuity).

arms.name: invented-a2
arms.note: A2 (headline steelman): stronger planner + nano workers, the SDK's documented recipe (README 'Use a capable model for the planner'; docs/recipes.md §3). gpt-5.4-mini is the next tier up in the worker's own family: same provider and API key (no provider confound), and LiteLLM-priced so planner cost is booked. Full gpt-5.4 is the stronger alternative (~3.3x mini's price).

repeats_derivation.synthesize: new type, no pilot CV -> cap (20). This is the upper bound the rule allows, so a 5-repeat re-derivation pilot can only lower it.

cost_estimate.basis: Pilot per-run means (§3: invented $0.0028, routed $0.0011, authored $0.0009). A2 is scaled by gpt-5.4-mini/nano list price (~3.7x) on the planner share, plus 2x worker cost for larger plans. The authored arm on material tasks fails fast at Tavily, so its line is an upper bound.
